title: Cortar retries de capability-boundary HTTP sin ocultar runtimes compatibles
mission: Implement a generic repeated-capability-boundary circuit breaker. When the same job has at least two materially equivalent terminal BOUNDARY returns for one required capability and no success/new material basis intervenes, compile a bounded capability_confirmation_required marker into its recovery route. For that marked recovery only, an ambiguous capability is not enough to claim: the worker must have definitive positive tool-contract evidence for the named capability; definitive absence or unknown skips before authority. Preserve the ordinary global rule that unknown capability is not absence outside this repeated-boundary gate.
definition_of_done: Detect repeated same-job same-required-capability terminal boundary evidence without scanning unbounded history.
Publish machine-readable capability_confirmation_required on the affected recovery/attention route only after the repeated-boundary threshold.
Workers with definitive positive capability evidence remain eligible; workers with absent or unknown evidence skip this gated retry before authority.
Ordinary first attempts and unrelated capabilities preserve unknown-is-not-absence semantics.
A new material success/basis clears or supersedes the repeated-boundary gate.
Add regression coverage using unrestricted_public_http_origin_fetch with two TTS boundary fixtures and one explicitly capable runtime fixture.
Do not add per-worker probes, target-specific network calls, human routing, or promotion authority.
